value.rationale: The intrinsic scientific question is whether repeated dryland sowing should be concentrated or spaced when rain is uncertain and viability decays. In the first-rain three-cohort model, the exact two sharp thresholds change the number of distinct optimal release dates from one to two to three, resolving the complete minimal three-cohort schedule and providing a tractable benchmark beyond qualitative multiple-seeding advice. This is not an arbitrary slice or mere numerical reoptimization; it gives a full classification and a unique algebraic interior branch, but it is neither field-calibrated nor a claim for other event laws.
